section_header: BODY ELECTRICAL SYSTEM — Theft Deterrent System
title: INSPECTION OF LH DOOR UNLOCK CIRCUIT / INSPECTION OF RH DOOR UNLOCK CIRCUIT

content.text: B INSPECTION OF LH DOOR UNLOCK CIRCUIT

content.description: Flowchart showing inspection steps for LH door unlock circuit, starting with inspection of door lock switch operation, then proceeding to computer circuit inspection

steps.condition:
INSPECT DOOR LOCK SWITCH OPERATION
Is LH door lock switch normal?
(See page BE-99)

INSPECT DOOR LOCK SWITCH CIRCUIT
Disconnect connector from computer.
Is there continuity between terminal 6 of connector side and body ground with LH door closed?
steps.if_yes: Short circuit in wire harness between terminal 6 of computer and terminal 1 of LH door lock switch.
